input.rationale: We searched the full agreement for most-favoured-nation / best-pricing language ("most favored", "no less favorable", "favourable", "lowest", "best price", "other customers", "similarly situated", "comparable", "preferential", "discount") and reviewed the only plausible homes for such a term: Section 4 (Fees), Exhibit B (Pricing, Revenue Sharing Fees, Payment Terms) and Exhibit D (Sales and Marketing Cooperation). Exhibit B sets fixed license, MarketSite.net access, maintenance, revenue-share and implementation amounts with no obligation for Corio to extend Commerce One terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and no obligation to match third-party offers. Exhibit D's cooperation commitments are expressly non-binding and contain no exclusivity or preferred-terms undertaking. There is therefore no MFN obligation burdening us, which is the playbook's preferred position; no redline is required.
